data.current_summary: Queue transcripts for up to 100 videos
data.current_description: Returns immediately with a batch_id; transcripts are fetched in the background. Poll GET /batch?id=... or pass webhook_url to be notified when it finishes. The call itself is free: 1 credit is charged per video that returns a transcript, and failed videos are never charged (e.g. 10 videos, 8 with captions = 8 credits; temporary failures are retried for you and never billed). Duplicate videos are fetched once. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries of this call safe. Webhooks POST {event, batch_id, status, total, succeeded, failed, credits_charged, results_url} with header X-GYT-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.<raw body>' keyed with webhook_secret>. At most 5 unfinished batches per account; results are kept for 7 days.
data.summary_suggestion: Submit up to 100 videos for asynchronous transcript extraction
data.description_suggestion: Submit a batch of up to 100 video IDs for asynchronous transcript extraction. Returns immediately with a batch_id for tracking. Transcripts are fetched in the background; poll GET /batch?id=... or provide webhook_url for completion notifications. Billing: 1 credit per successfully extracted transcript; failed videos are never charged. Duplicate videos are processed once. Use Idempotency-Key header for safe retries. Webhooks receive {event, batch_id, status, total, succeeded, failed, credits_charged, results_url} with X-GYT-Signature verification. Limits: maximum 5 unfinished batches per account; results retained for 7 days.

data.current_summary: Get a YouTube video transcript
data.current_description: Full transcript for one video, plus title/author/thumbnail metadata. One block of text by default; add 'timestamps=true' to also get 'segments', one {start, duration, text} per caption line (times in seconds). Same credit cost either way. Provenance: language_code is the caption track actually returned and can differ from requested_language (YouTube falls back to the track it has); caption_type is 'manual' (creator-uploaded) or 'auto' (speech recognition), null when unknown for older transcripts; cached says whether it came from our stored copy, fetched at fetched_at. Failed requests (no captions, unavailable video) are never charged.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve YouTube video transcript with metadata
data.description_suggestion: Fetches the full transcript for a specified YouTube video along with metadata (title, author, thumbnail). Returns transcript as a single text block by default; use 'timestamps=true' to receive segmented captions with timing data (start time, duration, text in seconds). Includes provenance information: language_code indicates the actual caption track returned (may differ from requested language due to YouTube fallback), caption_type shows 'manual' (creator-uploaded) or 'auto' (speech recognition), and cached indicates if the transcript came from stored cache with fetched_at timestamp. Costs 1 credit per successful request; failed requests (missing captions, unavailable videos) are never charged.

data.current_summary: Queue transcripts for up to 100 videos
data.current_description: Returns immediately with a batch_id; transcripts are fetched in the background. Poll GET /batch?id=... or pass webhook_url to be notified when it finishes. The call itself is free: 1 credit is charged per video that returns a transcript, and failed videos are never charged (e.g. 10 videos, 8 with captions = 8 credits; temporary failures are retried for you and never billed). Duplicate videos are fetched once. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries of this call safe. Webhooks POST {event, batch_id, status, total, succeeded, failed, credits_charged, results_url} with header X-GYT-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.<raw body>' keyed with webhook_secret>. At most 5 unfinished batches per account; results are kept for 7 days.
data.summary_suggestion: Submit up to 100 videos for asynchronous transcript extraction
data.description_suggestion: Submit a batch of up to 100 video IDs for asynchronous transcript extraction. Returns immediately with a batch_id for tracking. Transcripts are fetched in the background; poll GET /batch?id=... or provide webhook_url for completion notifications. Billing: 1 credit per successfully extracted transcript; failed videos are never charged. Duplicate videos are processed once. Use Idempotency-Key header for safe retries. Webhooks receive {event, batch_id, status, total, succeeded, failed, credits_charged, results_url} with X-GYT-Signature verification. Limits: maximum 5 unfinished batches per account; results retained for 7 days.

data.current_summary: Get a YouTube video transcript
data.current_description: Full transcript for one video, plus title/author/thumbnail metadata. One block of text by default; add 'timestamps=true' to also get 'segments', one {start, duration, text} per caption line (times in seconds). Same credit cost either way. Provenance: language_code is the caption track actually returned and can differ from requested_language (YouTube falls back to the track it has); caption_type is 'manual' (creator-uploaded) or 'auto' (speech recognition), null when unknown for older transcripts; cached says whether it came from our stored copy, fetched at fetched_at. Failed requests (no captions, unavailable video) are never charged.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve YouTube video transcript with metadata
data.description_suggestion: Fetches the full transcript for a specified YouTube video along with metadata (title, author, thumbnail). Returns transcript as a single text block by default; use 'timestamps=true' to receive segmented captions with timing data (start time, duration, text in seconds). Includes provenance information: language_code indicates the actual caption track returned (may differ from requested language due to YouTube fallback), caption_type shows 'manual' (creator-uploaded) or 'auto' (speech recognition), and cached indicates if the transcript came from stored cache with fetched_at timestamp. Costs 1 credit per successful request; failed requests (missing captions, unavailable videos) are never charged.
